subject: Itinerary update — propose hybrid demo during your site visit
messages:
From: Ruth Iglesias <ruth.iglesias@novellamed.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novella Events <events@novellamed.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novella visit — can we schedule an on-site demo?

Hi Laura,

Our team will be on-site in the Bay Area the week of May 10–13. We were hoping to schedule an in-person demo and a quick architecture walkthrough while we're there. Primary attendees will be our Head of IT (me), our Product Director Maria Lopez, and one of our board advisors.

Would you (or someone from the team) be available on Wednesday May 12 in the morning? We can be flexible on the exact time but would prefer an in-person deep-dive if possible.

I've attached our travel itinerary with arrival/departure times so you can see windows that work.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing you.

Ruth Iglesias
Head of IT, Novella Medical
ruth.iglesias@novellamed.com
Attachments: novella_travel_itinerary.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Novella visit — internal coordination

Aditya / Grace — quick internal note before I respond to Ruth.

Summary: Novella asked for an on-site demo on May 12 (morning). Their itinerary (attached) shows Maria and the board advisor arrive late on May 11 but Maria has a flight out early evening on May 12. That means the decision-makers may not both be physically present for a long hands-on session.

Proposed approach: offer a hybrid plan — a shorter in-person session focused on the workflow + hands-on for their engineers, and a synced virtual session for Maria and the advisor to join remotely for the executive Q&A. That preserves the on-site touchpoints while ensuring exec attendance.

Aditya: can you lead the hands-on bench session for ~40 minutes? We should bring the inference performance slides but keep the deep latency/cost math to the virtual sync. Grace: can you handle the executive Q&A facilitation and close on next steps/PO cadence?

I'll draft a reply to Ruth proposing the hybrid option and offering two time windows (May 12 morning or May 13 10–11am PT) in case their outbound plans compress.

Attachments: redwood_proposed_agenda.pdf (outline)

— Laura

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novella visit — propose hybrid demo plan and two windows

Hi Ruth — thanks for the note and for sending the itinerary. Excited to host you.

Quick update: one of your leadership attendees indicated they may need to return earlier than planned. To make sure everyone gets the content they need, I'd like to propose a hybrid approach so we cover the hands-on and the exec-level decisions cleanly. Two options:

Option A (preferred, keeps an in-person element):
- Date: May 12
- Time: 9:00–10:00am PT (on-site at Redwood demo lab)
- Format: 40 min hands-on bench session (Aditya will run the lab), followed by a 20 min executive Q&A that Maria or the advisor can join virtually. We'll set up a single room with a projector and a dedicated Zoom link so remote attendees can see the live demo.

Option B (fallback, if travel compresses):
- Date: May 13
- Time: 10:00–11:00am PT (virtual + one on-site seat)
- Format: Hybrid full walkthrough with recorded segments for any execs who need an async recap.

Please pick the option that best fits the final travel times. If helpful, I attached a short proposed agenda and can send a calendar invite for whichever slot you confirm.

We can also record the hands-on portion and share the recording for anyone who can't attend live.

Note to team (Aditya / Grace): if they pick Option A, please plan for the bench to be set up by 8:30am and bring the lightweight latency demo (30s end-to-end). Aditya — can you confirm you can lead Option A if needed?

Thanks — Laura

Attachments: redwood_proposed_agenda.pdf
Related link: https://cal.redwood.com/j/LAU-ADY-NOV-13

From: Ruth Iglesias <ruth.iglesias@novellamed.com>

Laura — thanks, this is great. Option B (May 13 10am PT) actually fits our adjusted schedule better — Maria's change in flights means she can only join remotely. Could you please send a calendar invite for May 13 10am PT and share the recording after? Also please include the Zoom link and dial-in for our remote attendees.

We'd like to keep someone on-site to run the hands-on bench for our engineers; Maria will join the Q&A remotely. Looking forward to it.

Ruth
